lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
The mirror holds a different light
A shadow where the sun should be
I step across the silver night
Into the depth of mystery
[chorus]
Falling through the folded seams
Lost within the waking dreams
A silent world, a neon glow
Where gravity has let me go
[verse]
The constellations hum a tune
In colors I have never known
Beneath a twice-reflected moon
I find the path I call my own
[chorus]
Falling through the folded seams
Lost within the waking dreams
A silent world, a neon glow
Where gravity has let me go
[bridge]
Time is liquid, memory thin
The veil is wearing out again
I am drifting, I am free
In this shifting reality
[chorus]
Falling through the folded seams
Lost within the waking dreams
A silent world, a neon glow
Where gravity has let me go
[outro]
